Describe the problem and what you expected to happen.

**Environment:** source commit/app version, macOS version, Apple Silicon model
family and console model/firmware family where relevant. Do not post serials,
console discovery identities, private IP addresses, credentials or show/customer data.

**Reproduction:** minimal steps using synthetic examples, observed result and
whether it also happens away from a live show.

**Evidence:** relevant redacted errors and checks you ran. A successful send and
a confirmed console state are different results; state which you observed.

For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting route in SECURITY.md instead.
